goal: Implement BIP 54 Consensus Cleanup validation rules on regtest without activating them on mainnet
Mitigate timewarp attacks, 64-byte transaction Merkle collisions, and legacy sigops CPU exhaustion
Enable developers to test, fuzz, and evaluate the consensus cleanup package directly in-tree
reviewability: Ready for review, with nothing known that would invalidate review now
agreement: Broad concept support for implementing BIP 54 rules without mainnet activation (0xB10C, dergoegge, fanquake)
Verified with extensive mutation testing across all rules and activation boundaries (instagibbs)
Verified sigops counting and test vectors against btclib and BIP specifications (fametrano)
Open suggestions remain for pre-activation mempool tests and cache edge cases (ariard, ViniciusCestarii)
